goals.objective: Make Woodpecker’s Forgejo OAuth login reliable on Ottawa by diagnosing and fixing the cluster-DNS failure for forgejo.keiretsu.top (NXDOMAIN from CoreDNS, which currently breaks the server-side access-token exchange), then apply only evidence-backed Woodpecker GitOps tuning (resources/agents/autoscaling) if login still fails or the queue is saturating.

tasks.title: Diagnose Woodpecker OAuth vs cluster DNS for forgejo.keiretsu.top
tasks.verificationContract: Show the live failure path from woodpecker-server logs plus how Ottawa CoreDNS/k8gb/public CNAME currently resolve forgejo.keiretsu.top from a pod vs from a laptop. Identify whether NXDOMAIN is k8gb split-horizon, CoreDNS forwarding, or a missing in-cluster record.
tasks.evidence: woodpecker-server logs at 2026-08-31T04:04:14Z: Post https://forgejo.keiretsu.top/login/oauth/access_token lookup on 10.2.0.10:53 no such host. Cause: CoreDNS/NodeLocal keiretsu.top zone forwards to 1

tasks.title: GitOps-fix in-cluster resolution of forgejo.keiretsu.top
tasks.verificationContract: After the GitOps change, a Woodpecker/Forgejo-namespace lookup of forgejo.keiretsu.top succeeds and woodpecker-server can POST https://forgejo.keiretsu.top/login/oauth/access_token without NXDOMAIN. tools/check.sh passes for the touched cluster(s). No Tailscale CGNAT addresses published in public DNS.

tasks.title: Verify Forgejo OAuth login and related server errors
tasks.verificationContract: woodpecker-server logs no longer show cannot authenticate user / lookup forgejo.keiretsu.top no such host on a login attempt. Related webhook/status errors that share the same DNS cause drop. Document any remaining non-DNS login failures.

tasks.title: Tune Woodpecker capacity only if evidence shows saturation
tasks.verificationContract: If agents/server/queue (webhook create, queue.Done, PVC Multi-Attach, CPU/memory) are saturating after DNS is fixed, land a GitOps change (replicas/resources/HPA) with before/after evidence. If not saturating, do not add autoscaling and record why.
tasks.evidence: No GitOps HPA/replica bump. After DNS fix: agents 1m CPU / 10–14Mi vs 250m/256Mi requests (3/3 ready); server 2m/42Mi vs 250m/256Mi. webhook create errors are 'when' filters, not queue overflow; queue
